description: This is the source code for the 'Tax' class in the Opencart System Library for the Cart module. It handles tax calculation, retrieval, and management for cart items, including setting addresses and computing applicable tax rates.

classes.name: Tax
classes.description: Class responsible for handling tax calculations within the Cart library, including setting addresses, retrieving tax rates, and calculating tax amounts.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the database and configuration objects using the registry.

methods.name: setShippingAddress
methods.description: Sets the shipping address for tax calculation based on country and zone IDs, and loads applicable tax rates.

methods.name: setPaymentAddress
methods.description: Sets the payment address for tax calculation based on country and zone IDs, and loads applicable tax rates.

methods.name: setStoreAddress
methods.description: Sets the store address for tax calculation based on country and zone IDs, and loads applicable tax rates.

methods.name: calculate
methods.description: Calculates the total amount including tax based on the value and tax class ID.

methods.name: getTax
methods.description: Retrieves the total tax amount applicable to a value and tax class ID.

methods.name: getRates
methods.description: Returns the applicable tax rates for a value and tax class ID.

methods.name: getRateName
methods.description: Returns the name of a specific tax rate given its ID.
